fixture.notes: instrument_probe is the PRIMARY regression test for WP2.4: it builds its own agent.jar from a hand-rolled `ClassFileTransformer` that scans for `bipush 42` (0x10 0x2a) inside the Target classfile bytes and patches the operand to 99. No external jars required. jacoco_probe and mockito_probe additionally exercise WP2.4 against real-world agents — they skip-with-clear-message when the matching jar is absent.

instrument.notes: Today's reality (2026-04-29 session 99): rc=0 — the full agent retransform pipeline works. Premain runs, isRetransformClassesSupported returns true, addTransformer succeeds, retransformClasses fires the transformer which patches `bipush 42` → `bipush 99` in Target.class, and the retransformed Target.compute() returns 99. Required fixes that landed this session: (a) public-name aliases on InstrumentationImpl for isRetransform/isRedefine/isNativeMethodPrefixSupported, isModifiableClass, getObjectSize, getAllLoadedClasses, retransformClasses, redefineClasses; (b) promoted Class.forName(String) / forName(String,Z,ClassLoader) / forName(Module,String) overloads from `register_synthetic_overrides` (synthetic-jdk-only) into `register_essential_natives` (always registered). Combined with the WP2.4 v1+v2 work + WP2.5 v1+v2+v3 (real bytecode generator + UTE wrapping + static Method[] slots), this is end-to-end JVMTI-style javaagent retransform working under cratonvm.

jacoco.notes: rc=0 today — main() runs to completion because cratonvm's agent_loader catches the JaCoCo premain NPE and continues (without the transformer registered). The `jacoco.exec` file gets created (0-byte placeholder) but contains NO coverage data because the transformer never installed. Once 2.4-A's full Instrumentation surface lands AND 2.4-B's class_manager retransform path is wired, JaCoCo's premain completes, the rewriter installs, and `jacoco.exec` after main() exits should be >300 bytes and start with 0x01 0xC0 0xC0 (JaCoCo execdata magic). At that point flip expected_jacoco_exec_nonempty + expected_jacoco_magic_ok to true and clear the expected_stderr_contains entries.

mockito.notes: Mockito's MockMaker SPI bootstrap (org.mockito.plugins.MockMaker) walks ByteBuddy's class loader chain, which trips the same NPE inside net.bytebuddy.utility.dispatcher.JavaDispatcher.<clinit> documented in WP2.3 (bench/wave2-3 baseline). On top of that, even when ByteBuddy clinit succeeds, the inline MockMaker needs runtime class redefinition via the Instrumentation API — that's exactly the WP2.4-A surface. So Mockito requires BOTH WP2.3 (defineClass family) AND WP2.4 (Instrumentation.retransformClasses) to land before this probe flips. expected_final_rc remains 1 until then. After: clear the expected_stderr_contains entries and add `mock-class=`, `default-int=0`, `stubbed-int=42`, and `OK` to expected_stdout_contains.

known_blockers.summary: vm/src/runtime/instrument.rs must register the full sun/instrument/InstrumentationImpl native surface (isRetransformClassesSupported0, retransformClasses0, redefineClasses0, getAllLoadedClasses0, isModifiableClass0, getObjectSize0). Today only an in-process bridge exists (cratonvm.Instrument). Premain calls into the java.lang.instrument.Instrumentation API which is implemented as sun.instrument.InstrumentationImpl in OpenJDK; that bridge needs the natives wired.

classloading/src/class_manager.rs must support full bytecode redefinition: retransformClasses must re-run the transformer chain on already-loaded classes, parse the new bytes, swap the method table in place, invalidate vtable / itable / JIT caches.

vm-cli/src/main.rs + vm/src/runtime/agent_loader.rs already parse `-javaagent:foo.jar` and dispatch premain (verified today: instrument_probe stdout shows 'agent: premain entered'). Remaining gap: agent_loader must also pass the actual Instrumentation reference to premain (currently fails on the InstrumentationImpl <init>(JLjava/lang/String;ZZ)V signature).

Mockito + ByteBuddy bootstrap fails inside ByteBuddy's JavaDispatcher.<clinit> with NPE on Method[] arraylength. Same blocker family already documented in bench/wave2-3/bench-baseline.json. mockito_probe will only flip after WP2.3 is green AND WP2.4 is green.

definition_of_pass:
Per-probe pass criteria:
 - instrument: rc=0; stdout contains 'agent: premain entered', 'agent: addTransformer done', 'agent: retransformClasses done', 'before=99', 'after=99', 'OK'.
 - jacoco: rc=0; stdout already passes today; after WP2.4-A/B land the jacoco.exec file must be >300 bytes and start with the magic 0x01 0xC0 0xC0.
 - mockito: rc=0; stdout contains 'mock-class=', 'default-int=0', 'stubbed-int=42', 'stubbed-string=hi-foo', 'OK'.

When all three flip, clear the per-probe `expected_stderr_contains[]` arrays and add OK to `expected_stdout_contains[]`.
